AutoZone, Inc. retails and distributes automotive replacement parts and accessories. The company has market cap of $16.66 billion. It offers various products for cars, sport utility vehicles, vans, and light trucks, including new and remanufactured automotive hard parts, maintenance items, accessories, and non-automotive products. It has a 13.12 P/E ratio.
